name: VC Trader AI Get Report
description: Reads one published report in full, including its block body. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF at GET /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/reports/{report_id} as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN, ADR 0078). READ_ONLY per core/openclaw/allowlist.py. A retracted report still resolves here and carries its retraction reason.
